scenario_description: A saved seven-day escalation in the Strait of Hormuz, June 18–24, 2025, from diplomatic tension to a full closure.

signals.title: Tensions rise in Gulf as Iran warns of retaliation over strikes
signals.body: Iran warns of retaliation over strikes, with diplomatic tension rising across the Persian Gulf.

signals.title: Iran considers closing Strait of Hormuz, officials say
signals.body: Officials say Iran is considering closing the Strait of Hormuz if hostilities escalate further.

signals.title: Iran orders naval buildup near Strait of Hormuz
signals.body: Iran orders a naval buildup near the Strait of Hormuz, deploying additional warships to the area.

signals.title: US and allies impose fresh sanctions on Iran oil exports
signals.body: The United States and allies impose fresh sanctions on Iran oil exports amid the standoff.

signals.title: Iran threatens to close Strait of Hormuz as oil tankers reroute
signals.body: Iran threatens to close the Strait of Hormuz as oil tankers reroute away from the chokepoint.

signals.title: Shipowners report GPS jamming near Strait of Hormuz
signals.body: Shipowners report GPS jamming incidents affecting tanker navigation near the Strait of Hormuz.

signals.title: Missile attack strikes oil tanker near Hormuz
signals.body: A missile attack struck an oil tanker near Hormuz, the vessel's operator confirmed.

signals.title: Port terminal disruption reported at Gulf loading facility
signals.body: A port terminal disruption was reported at a major Gulf crude loading facility following the attack.

signals.title: Second tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, crew evacuated
signals.body: A second tanker was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz and its crew was evacuated, officials said.

signals.title: Iran closes Strait of Hormuz to oil tanker traffic
signals.body: Iran closes the Strait of Hormuz to oil tanker traffic, halting a fifth of global crude flows.
